question: Seriously, how long did it take to think up a story this grand? Did a fair amount of your friend’s opinions go into fleshing out the plot?
answer: I made the framework in about a week, and my friend just listened to me to help my fill in the details of the story. So his role was mostly encouraging me by saying “It’s fine, isn’t it?” about the content I created, and his opinion’s weren’t really involved . I made up everything myself.
